name: r2-oproj-rinit-tmem-ab
author: solx-loop
description: H15: put the residual into the TMEM accumulator before the K loop, so the epilogue needs no C operand. The epilogue warps load the next tile's R block (bf16 to fp32) and tcgen05.st it into the accumulator stage their previous store drained. An acc_init mbarrier per stage hands it to the MMA warp, which then always accumulates. A CTA's first tile instead accumulates from zero and gets R added in TMEM after its MMA. Rented B200 result: correct 16/16 but 1.5% slower than the parent's fused-C kernel
